changelog:
- Calibrated Facebook Reactions: Integrated UI-based post reactions (Love, Care, Haha, Wow, Sad, Angry) matching custom layouts like Reels mirrored direction and tapping coordinates offset.
- Optimized Combo Flow: Updated SMM combo sequence to run React -> Share -> Comment with smart screen detection to avoid reopening standard posts and Reels unnecessarily.
- Notifications Simulator: Added automated notification clearing and reading simulation steps before tasks.
- Clean Backup State: Automatically redirects the Facebook app back to the News Feed before saving account backups.
